signs.aquarius: Reflect on how past experiences and existing knowledge can be applied toward present inspirations, darling Aquarius. Your focus elevates while Luna and Mercury RX unite in the sector of your chart that governs success, stirring up a hunger for professional growth and notoriety; faking it until you make it won't get you very far. However, a willingness to experiment and own mistakes that occur along the way could. As Saturn activates, get creative to develop skills that will assist your journey. Break down your ultimate goals into smaller increments under tonight's New Moon, homing in on your plan for the next six months.
signs.aries: You have a chance to make impactful changes, dearest Aries, as Luna aligns with Mercury RX and Saturn before tonight's Scorpio New Moon. Reflect on your closest partnerships and where you draw power, noting where adjustments are needed. When dealing with others, it's important to establish clear lines of communication; otherwise, your counterpart might feel as though you're steamrolling them. Major commitments are likely to arise over the next six months, and having a clear vision of where you want to be will make it easier to decide which offers to accept or turn down.
signs.cancer: Embrace activities that ease your mind while still offering creative or intellectual challenges, sweet Cancer. You're due for some fun and artistic stimulation while Luna and Mercury RX unite in your solar fifth house. Returning to projects or hobbies that have been collecting dust will revive vibrant parts of the spirit that may have gone dormant recently. Recognize if you've been too caught up in serious endeavors to enjoy the lighter side of life when Saturn activates, silently vowing to break such cycles. Make a wish from the center of your heart under tonight's New Moon, and watch your dreams manifest throughout the next six months.
signs.capricorn: You're in a reflective headspace early this morning, darling Capricorn, as Luna and Mercury RX unite in emotionally evolved Scorpio. You may decide it's time to branch out socially or reconnect with friends you once felt outgrown. A desire to transform and build success is highlighted when Saturn activates, but you'll need strong role models to gain wisdom and guidance from. You also need to build more consistent, productive habits and set boundaries with people who demand too much. The New Moon rises later tonight, inspiring you to set networking and professional goals for the next six months.
signs.gemini: Your morning gets off to a busy yet disorganized start, darling Gemini, as Luna and Mercury RX join forces. As you scramble to clean up messes, make appointments on time, or prepare for the upcoming workweek, recognize how frequently these issues arise. Frustrating as this energy may be, it offers an opportunity to identify chaotic cycles and replace them with healthier, more efficient ones. Acknowledge the role technological distractions play in your ability to stay on task when Saturn activates. Embrace simple changes to your daily and weekly routines under tonight's New Moon, and you will see great improvements throughout the next six months.
signs.leo: Old memories could stir conflicting emotions this morning, dearest Leo, as Luna and Mercury RX unite in Scorpio. Acknowledge both the good and the bad to balance your view of the past. Meanwhile, Saturn activates in the sector of your chart that governs spirituality and growth. Separate yourself from outside commentary to uncover personal truths. You may realize that certain people have been trying to impose their opinions on you to shift your perspective. Prioritize your emotional needs and most trusted relationships under tonight's New Moon, which encourages you to get cozy at home with your favorite companions.
signs.libra: Luna and Mercury RX join forces in transformative Scorpio, darling Libra, activating the sector of your chart that governs material goods and wealth. Your mind sharpens as your senses awaken, helping you see the world differently. Get creative by upcycling, selling, or refurbishing items that hold value but that you have little use for. If you're in a partnership with joint finances, discuss future goals as Saturn activates, noting how current spending habits affect them. Update your budget to fortify shared dreams under tonight's New Moon, homing in on what the next six months will look like.
signs.pisces: The universe connects with you in playful yet repetitive ways, dearest Pisces. As Luna and Mercury RX unite in the sector of your chart that governs spirituality, reflect on what your higher power might be trying to say. Ask for signs when you need clarity, and don't hesitate to make a few wishes. Check in with your gratitude and acknowledge your current responsibilities when Saturn activates. Before attempting to manifest more, you must show the other side that you can maintain today's blessings. Tonight's New Moon marks one of the most spiritually significant moments of 2026. Embrace your inner mystic and release any doubts that could be compromising your faith.
signs.sagittarius: Pay extra attention to any recurring dreams or thoughts that greet you upon awakening, darling Sagittarius. Luna and Mercury RX join forces early this morning, dusting up forgotten memories that require a second glance. Reflect quietly to find deeper meaning, and ask questions if you're unsure where the universe is guiding you. You may feel dissatisfied by a lack of recognition within creative or professional fields once Saturn activates. Instead of succumbing to recent plateaus, consider whether you've been playing it safe. You'll have a chance to release internalized obstacles so you can truly charge forward when the Scorpio New Moon rises tonight.
signs.scorpio: You'll be in a quiet and reserved mood this morning, darling Scorpio, as Luna and Mercury RX unite in your sign. Important discussions may arise at any moment. Pause to consider your options and craft your message before you send it. Stress levels elevate as Saturn activates, and you could misspeak or agree to terms you're not fully on board with. Putting it on paper may be easier than a face-to-face conversation. If you need to get something off your chest, write it out or rehearse with a trusted friend before you speak with the relevant parties. You'll feel light, peaceful, and inspired to pursue your best life under tonight's New Moon. Use this energy to make a special birthday-season wish, focusing on the hope you want to gain over the next six months.
signs.taurus: A sweet and transcendent energy surrounds you early this morning, dearest Taurus, as Luna and Mercury RX unite in your solar seventh house. This celestial union seeks to uplift strained relationships and mend broken hearts. Forgive those you can reconcile with, and seek closure from anyone you can't. Just don't force yourself to reconnect with someone you've gone no contact with while Saturn activates. Trust that you have the power to resolve unfinished business on your own. The Scorpio New Moon rises tonight, signaling that you have plenty to look forward to throughout the next six months, especially when it comes to matters of the heart.
signs.virgo: Revisit conversations or ideas that were left unfinished, dearest Virgo. The mind has a way of tugging at loose ends when Luna and Mercury RX unite in investigative Scorpio. You'll struggle to shake stories that never made sense, which will put you on a fact-finding mission. Be mindful of how you gather information while Saturn activates, and use facts to validate intuitive hunches. Don't hesitate to point out inconsistencies others relay, but expect pushback from those who feel attacked. Spend some time with people you trust implicitly once the New Moon rises tonight, reminding yourself that there are solid, loving, and loyal companions on your side.
